\section{Reproducibility}
\label{app:repro}

From the manuscript directory, run
\begin{verbatim}
python3 supplement/exact_linear_algebra.py --verify
python3 -m unittest supplement.test_exact_linear_algebra -v
latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error \
  -outdir=build main.tex
\end{verbatim}
The first command reconstructs both theorem-critical spectra for all eight
interior links and compares the result with the stored JSON certificate.  The
second checks block counts, orientation-sensitive spectra, the exact
polynomial backend, KKT identities, and the stored certificate.  Python,
NumPy, and SciPy are used; the proof arithmetic itself uses Python integers
and \texttt{fractions.Fraction}.

The source archive contains the manuscript, certificate, verifier, tests,
proof-audit artifacts, and build report.  Generated PDF auxiliary files are
not mathematical inputs.
